official_semantics.finding: TIMESTAMPTZ is microsecond; DuckDB warns timezone-aware nanosecond Parquet columns can lose precision. Canonical replay stores UTC nanoseconds as BIGINT and JSON decimal strings.
Use explicit nanosecond conversion and overflow rejection; existing package version 3.0.6 is separate from reviewed repository main.
Article created/updated timestamps do not authenticate original receipt or immutable revision history; preserve raw payload versions and original observation.
Trades/quotes support nanosecond timestamps; updated bars, trade corrections and cancellations require observed-version replay.
